areas.summary: Strong publicly visible evidence for enrichment and extra-curricular activity (10 specific items). Listed provision includes religious education, geography, music, art, drama, appraise music, physical education, after-school club…. 2 items corroborated across multiple pages.

signals.text: In small classes, the children have weekly sessions of French, Geography, History and Religious Education, PSHE, Music, Art, Design T echnology and ICT, PE and Sport.
There is also a popular after school Drama club which leads to The London Academy of Music and Dramatic Arts (LAMDA) exams.
It should be a creative and enjoyable activity and we provide opportunities for all children to compose, perform and appraise music, to develop the skills to appreciate a wide variety of music.
Specialist teaching enhances provision, particularly in languages, music, art and physical education.
It’s a great chance for our pupils to take part in something new, or something that complements the academic and sporting curriculum in a safe, familiar environment.

What the school seeks to do 1.4 The school seeks to provide a nurturing community, where respect, empathy, compassion and kindness are core.
Herries is a small, family-focused community that provides pupils with high academic standards, a varied curriculum within an inclusive, nurturing environment and rich extra-curricular opportunities.
